WITH ACCOUNT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountSk),0) RN FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT 

)
, CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter 
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter A
	JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1' AND A.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS')
)
, CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL A
	JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL GROUP BY CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = B.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS')
)

,DimAccount_RIB AS(
SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK
,* 
--INTO DW.ACCOUNT_OTH
FROM ( 
    
SELECT DISTINCT 
BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
--,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
--,CASE 
--     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
--     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
--,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
--,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
--,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode

--,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate

--,0 AS TaskRunId
--,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
